calculation.expression: -((return_20d - cross_sectional_median(return_20d)) / rolling_std(daily_return,20)) when VIX < rolling_median(VIX,120); otherwise null
calculation.description: Within subdued implied-volatility regimes, rank assets by the negative of their 20-session cross-sectional residual momentum, scaled by 20-session realized volatility. The negative sign is intentional: validation finds contrarian continuation benefit from laggards over the tested forward horizons. VIX is observation-only and never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Aggregate IC/ICIR pass the benchmark-wide absolute gates, but the signal is active on roughly one third of dates and uses a small cross-asset sample. IC uncertainty is therefore material; use as a conditional ensemble component rather than standalone portfolio driver.
